ApprovalWorkflowRequest.title: ApprovalWorkflowRequest

ContactRequest.title: ContactRequest

CreateFiscalYearRequest.description: A year of twelve months from `starts_on`, plus its adjustment period.
CreateFiscalYearRequest.title: CreateFiscalYearRequest

DimensionRequest.description: Create (code and name) or rename (PUT: name and the `version` it was based on) a dimension.
DimensionRequest.title: DimensionRequest

DimensionValueRequest.description: Create (code, name, optional parent value) or rename (PUT: name and `version`) a dimension value.
DimensionValueRequest.title: DimensionValueRequest

ExchangeRateRequest.description: A manual rate: 1 `from_currency` = `rate` `to_currency` on `rate_date`. The rate is a decimal string (D1: up to 8 decimals).
ExchangeRateRequest.title: ExchangeRateRequest

anyOf.description: The reopen request waiting on this period, if any (loaded with the year list).

FxRevaluationRequest.description: `period_id` (a period of this company; another company's is a 404 from the Action) and an optional `as_of` inside it. Also the preview's query.
FxRevaluationRequest.title: FxRevaluationRequest

reversal_pending.description: True while the automatic reversal is waiting for the next period to exist and be open.

line_total_fc.description: Net of discount, before tax; the tax of the line and its share per tax code (D2).

tax_detail.description: tax code id → minor units of the document currency

InvoiceRequest.description:
Create (POST) or replace (PUT, with `version`) a draft invoice, credit note, bill or debit note. Shape only:
ids exist in this company, quantities and rates are decimal strings, prices whole minor units. Totals, tax and
base amounts are not accepted: whatever the client sends for them is ignored and the server calculates.
Whether the contact fits the kind, the tax code has a rate that day, or the rate exists is the Action's call.

Line dimensions are `{"<dimension id>": "<dimension value id>"}`. On `/bills` the kind is purchase_bill
(default) or debit_note; on `/invoices` sales_invoice (default) or credit_note.
InvoiceRequest.title: InvoiceRequest

lines.description: The list answers summaries; one document comes with its lines.

ItemRequest.description: Create (POST) and replace (PUT, with the `version` it was based on) an item. Prices are whole minor units of its currency.
ItemRequest.title: ItemRequest

currency.description: Foreign-currency lines: the signed amount in that currency (+debit / -credit) and the rate to base.

JournalRequest.description:
Create (POST) or replace (PUT, with `version`) a draft journal. Shape only: ids exist in this company,
amounts are whole minor units, a line is a debit or a credit, a foreign-currency line carries its rate and
amount. Whether the journal balances, the period is open or dimension rules hold is the posting
validator's call (preview / submit), not the form's.

Line dimensions are `{"<dimension id>": "<dimension value id>"}`.
JournalRequest.title: JournalRequest

lines.description: The list answers summaries; one journal comes with its lines.

ReasonRequest.description: A required free-text explanation: `reason` for a reopen request, `comment` for rejecting one.
ReasonRequest.title: ReasonRequest

ReverseJournalRequest.description: Optional `date` (YYYY-MM-DD; default per D3), `memo` and the `version` the reversal is based on.
ReverseJournalRequest.title: ReverseJournalRequest

current_password.description: Changing the signing PIN re-proves the password; the PIN itself is checked by PinPolicy.

TaxCodeRequest.description:
Create (POST: the code, and optionally its first rate) and replace (PUT: everything but the code, with the
`version` it was based on) a tax code. Rates are fractions as strings: "0.05" is 5%.
TaxCodeRequest.title: TaxCodeRequest

rate.description: The rate in force today as a fraction ("0.050000" is 5%); null when none is.

TaxGroupRequest.description: Create (POST) and replace (PUT: name and items, with the `version` it was based on) a tax group. Items are in sequence.
TaxGroupRequest.title: TaxGroupRequest

TaxRateRequest.description: A new rate of a tax code from a date (inclusive), with the code's `version` it was based on.
TaxRateRequest.title: TaxRateRequest

TransitionRequest.description: A document transition (submit, approve): the version it was based on is optional, a comment too.
TransitionRequest.title: TransitionRequest

VersionRequest.description: A change that must name the version it was based on (13 §11): `{"version": 3}`.
VersionRequest.title: VersionRequest

WebhookEndpointRequest.description: Create or update an endpoint. `version` is required on update (the route has a webhook id).
WebhookEndpointRequest.title: WebhookEndpointRequest

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
